# Agent Journal (structured notes)
<!-- sections: ## Findings | ## Leads | ## Questions | ## Decisions -->

## Findings
- Repo is requests at v2.9.0 (5f7a3a74). Issue #2931: binary body fails; cause = commit edc68a0a ("fix issue #2844") changed `_encode_params` to `return to_native_string(data)`, which ASCII-decodes bytes bodies in Py3 -> UnicodeDecodeError on non-ASCII (models.py:84 -> utils.py:700).
- Fix applied (working tree, uncommitted): `_encode_params` back to `return data`; native-string conversion for params moved into `prepare_url` (`if isinstance(params, (str, bytes)): params = to_native_string(params)`), mirroring modern upstream (2.34.2). Diff: requests/models.py +7/-1. No test files touched, nothing committed.
- First fix attempt (bytes-only early return inside `_encode_params`) broke `test_params_bytes_are_encoded` (#2844 feature): bytes params must become str before URL splicing. Caught by running the fixture-free tests; rewritten.

## Leads
- Full suite (167 tests) can't run as-is: module fixture `def httpbin(httpbin)` at test_requests.py:51 shadows pytest-httpbin's fixture -> "recursive dependency" error on modern pytest; pre-existing, unrelated to fix.
- 85 fixture-free tests: 82 pass, 3 fail on network scope (doesnotexist.google.com, 10.255.255.1) — fail identically on pristine v2.9.0.

## Questions
- (none open)

## Decisions
- Validation recipe: `PYTHONPATH=C:/Windows/Temp/pyshim <campaign venv>/bin/python` from project root; C:/Windows/Temp/pyshim/sitecustomize.py shims collections.abc names (2.9.0 predates py3.10 collections ABC removal). cwd shadows site-packages, so local tree is what imports.
